versions.changelog:
xhs-report-generate v1.0.0

- Initial release of a Xiaohongshu (小红书) data tool for public note search, note detail and comment viewing, creator post tracking, and comment acquisition.
- Designed for trend discovery, competitor analysis, KOL screening, and structured data output to assist in content growth and marketing efforts on Xiaohongshu.
- Supports four main capabilities: keyword search, note detail, creator posts monitoring, and comment extraction.
- Does not require user account login; works via Node.js and external API token setup.
- Includes clear input guidelines, usage routes, failure handling, and recommended use cases for efficient data-driven content planning.
